description: My Community Explorer is an interactive dashboard of the U.S. Census Bureau that brings selected demographic, business and resilience information for states, counties and communities into one map-based tool. It combines American Community Survey estimates, Community Resilience Estimates of social vulnerability to disasters, County Business Patterns and Nonemployer Statistics, presented as maps, interactive dashboards and tables, so users can identify areas whose residents and businesses have less capacity to absorb the impacts of a disaster. A separate My Community Explorer for Puerto Rico uses the Puerto Rico Community Survey, Community Resilience Estimates for Puerto Rico and County Business Patterns, with a help PDF. Coverage: the United States and Puerto Rico; the dashboards were updated in July 2026 according to their ArcGIS item metadata. Access: ArcGIS Experience web applications published by the Census open data account, free to use without login; underlying statistics are public domain and downloadable from their source programs. Caveats: a viewer, not a dataset, with no bulk download of its own; statistics inherit the survey margins of error and suppression of the source products, and the combined indicators are not documented on a census.gov page. Simulation uses: screening communities for social and business vulnerability before selecting study areas, and communicating exposure results in resilience and emergency planning studies. Related records: Community Resilience Estimates, ACS tables, County Business Patterns and OnTheMap for Emergency Management.
